assets.prompt: Production 2D GAME SPRITE ATLAS for the approved cut-paper shadow theatre game. Use the attached image as STYLE reference only: sculptural folded paper with fibrous rough edges, layered torn-paper planes, warm ivory highlights, restrained shadows, angular origami articulated joints. NO painted backdrop, NO contact shadows, NO labels or letters, NO UI, NO card borders. TRUE transparent alpha outside the figures. EXACTLY 3 COLUMNS by 2 ROWS, SIX clearly different full-body animation states of ONE consistent enemy facing LEFT. Each equal cell is independent, with each figure entirely INSIDE the central 76% of its cell. Leave at least 12% COMPLETELY EMPTY transparent margin on ALL four sides of EACH cell. No overlapping poses across cell edges; cloak, hands, leaves and broken fragments must stay within cell. Keep whole feet visible. Same physical scale across standing states; collapse and heap naturally lower, with empty space above them. Row-major states: 1 idle ready; 2 obvious pre-attack windup with striking arm lifted; 3 full attack thrust LEFT; 4 hurt recoil backward with folded joints separating slightly; 5 actual folding-body collapse, buckling joints; 6 low wide disassembled heap grounded at the bottom, no floating fragments above. Transparent gaps are critical because the game crops equal cells. Make all poses consistent in identity and costume. Art quality and material detail match approved reference. Enemy: THE MOSSKEEPER, an ORIGINAL bulky gorilla made of layered muted moss-green and ochre leaf paper. Huge long angular arms with folded leaf cuffs, broad chest of overlapping cut leaves, short powerful legs, ivory folded brow and muzzle, dark expressive small eyes. Clearly recognizable as a massive leaf-paper ape, distinct from a skeleton and a hooded mage. Soft warm sage silhouette with darker forest green interior folds, small terracotta thread binding at shoulders, no horns, no weapon. Attack is left knuckle reaching/punching forward. Hurt shows leaf shoulder plates separating, collapse opens major folded body panels, final heap is broken green leaves, ivory muzzle and curled paper fists. Landscape atlas.
